prompt: A character expression sheet: a three by three grid of nine round portrait medallions of one person, the person in the reference image, in reading order, each head and shoulders, facing the viewer front on, the same framing, size and head position in every medallion, each on a plain warm-cream round ground with a thin dark ring, with clear space between. The same person in every portrait, with exactly the same face, hair, outfit and trims as the reference; only the expression and posture change, and the changes are bold and readable at a small size. Original design, not resembling any real person or film character. The person: a big older man with short grey hair, a full grey beard and tinted sunglasses (the sunglasses stay on in every portrait except downed, where they have slipped down the nose and the closed eyes show), a black and ivory panelled coat with a chrome-banded standing collar. Portrait 3, noticed, being watched: eyes flicking sideways, tense jaw, shoulders raised, a guarded look. Portrait 4, under fire: a flinch, head ducked low, eyes squeezed half shut, shoulders hunched, teeth bared. Portrait 5, firing: gritted teeth, one eye narrowed to aim, hard set jaw, head turned slightly as if sighting a target. Portrait 6, hurt: wincing, one eye shut, a small graze and a thin trickle of blood on the cheek, a clenched jaw. Portrait 7, badly hurt: grey drawn face, sweat, a bloodied brow and lip, heavy half-open eyes, hair and collar disordered. Portrait 8, downed: eyes closed, head slumped to one side, slack mouth, pale, a bruise and a smear of blood. Portrait 9, success: a small satisfied smile, a calm bright confident look, chin a little raised.
